title: ID0446567-DC/Si-D/SE [RVP / T2 170004470] Issues with communication with dispenser
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
When we added the dispenser during todays commssioning when got all outlets out of order. When checking error flags  we suspected faulty communication with dispenser. We checked the cables and everything seems okay. We got link on XF5 port p7. We saw the following in the logs.
Because the charger is in fw 6.0.3 L2&L3 can't ssh into the charger and troubleshoot and we can't update the charger because it seems to be missing the hawkbit file.
We need support from R&D. I have removed the dispenser configuration so that at least two outlets are working.
